newsitem.title: USA: Reliv says sales rose 35 percent in May.
newsitem.headline: Reliv says sales rose 35 percent in May.

text.p: Reliv International Inc said Tuesday its U.S. retail sales in May rose to $5.6 million, about 35 percent higher than sales in May 1996.

Net sales for the first two months of the second quarter rose to $7.1 million from $5.2 million for the same two months in 1996, the company said. Net sales reflect retail sales less commissions and discounts paid to the company's independent distributors. Reliv makes and sells nutritional supplements and meal replacement products.

A number of factors have driven the growth, including improved distributor recruitment and retention, successful sales training and marketing programs and product introductions, Robert Montgomery, president and chief executive of Reliv, said in a statement.

"We're delighted to see the company's dynamic growth continue," Montgomery said. "It proves that our product strategy is on track, and that Reliv is quickly developing one of the industry's most productive networks of independent distributors."
